plane-mortal.name: Mortal Domain (Five Continents)
plane-mortal.description: The vast mortal domain comprising the Western, Eastern, Southern, Northern, and Central Continents.

plane-sacred-domain.name: Sacred Domain (Upper Realm)
plane-sacred-domain.description: The pinnacle realm where Saint and Sovereign level experts reside, ancient home of the 8 Demonic Emperors.

plane-chaos-void.name: Primal Chaos Void
plane-chaos-void.description: The primordial origin realm where the Heavenly Sovereign and Supreme Dao converge.

stage-foundation.name: Foundation & Qi Gathering
stage-foundation.description: Initial realm where mortal cultivators cleanse meridians and condense spiritual qi into their dantian.

stage-qi-condensation.name: Qi Condensation Stage
stage-qi-condensation.description: Spiritual qi liquefies, allowing internal circulation, defensive shields, and martial technique projection.

stage-bone-tempering.name: Bone Tempering Stage
stage-bone-tempering.description: Refining the skeletal structure and marrow to achieve inhuman physical strength, speed, and diamond resilience.

stage-profound-heaven.name: Profound Heaven Stage
stage-profound-heaven.description: Unlocking divine consciousness and aerial flight, projecting Yuan Qi wings or floating directly through Heaven and Earth energy.

stage-radiant.name: Radiant Stage
stage-radiant.description: Soul consciousness solidifies into divine sense weapons; can kill enemies invisibly through mental shocks from miles away.

stage-ethereal.name: Ethereal Stage
stage-ethereal.description: Cultivators condense a physical Soul Avatar (Dragon Soul, Demonic Soul, Heaven Cleaving Blade) capable of independent devastating warfare.

stage-soul-harmony.name: Soul Harmony Stage
stage-soul-harmony.description: Merging the soul avatar seamlessly with the physical body, granting extreme vitality, physical immunity, and morphing powers.

stage-genesis.name: Genesis Stage
stage-genesis.description: Returning to primordial genesis; can manifest sovereign domains, manipulating the fundamental elemental laws of reality.

stage-saint.name: Saint Stage (King Stage)
stage-saint.description: Transcending the mortal domain, grasping World Law strings and living for hundred-thousand-year lifespans.

stage-half-sovereign.name: Half Sovereign Stage
stage-half-sovereign.description: Stepping halfway into the Sovereign Realm, wielding absolute dao laws capable of erasing continents with a glance.

stage-sovereign.name: Sovereign Stage (Demonic Emperor)
stage-sovereign.description: The legendary apex of the universe: Nine Serenities, Heavenly Sovereign, Demonic Emperor, Overlord Sovereign. Master of cosmic origin.

faction-luo.name: Luo Clan
faction-luo.description: Rising from a ruined backwater family in Windgale City, transformed by Grand Butler Zhuo Fan into Tianyu’s supreme hegemon.

faction-regent.name: Regent Estate
aliases: Head of the Seven Noble Houses
faction-regent.description: The undisputed dominant power of the 7 Noble Houses for a millennium, ambitious schemers seeking to supplant the Imperial throne.

faction-drifting-flowers.name: Drifting Flowers Edifice
faction-drifting-flowers.description: All-female noble house revered for beauty and ancient arts; home of Chu Qingcheng and the sacred Bodhi Jade Sap.

faction-veiled-dragon.name: Veiled Dragon Pavilion
faction-veiled-dragon.description: Noble house controlling immense merchant trade and subterranean dragon vein resources; Zhuo Fan’s earliest aristocratic ally.

faction-sword-marquise.name: Sword Marquise Abode
faction-sword-marquise.description: Proud martial house dedicated entirely to the extreme way of the sword, led by Xie Xiaofeng and martial maniac Xie Tianshang.

faction-hell-valley.name: Hell Valley
faction-hell-valley.description: Sinister demonic noble house specialized in yin ghosts, blood shadows, and stealth assassination; Zhuo Fan’s first blood enemy.

faction-pill-king.name: Pill King Hall
faction-pill-king.description: Monopolizers of Tianyu’s pill alchemy industry, former masters of Vicious Pill King Yan Song before their downfall.

faction-merry-woods.name: Merry Woods
faction-merry-woods.description: Noble house managing pleasure quarters, entertainment, and shadow intelligence, allied closely with Regent Estate.

faction-tianyu-imperial.name: Tianyu Imperial Court & Dugu Army
faction-tianyu-imperial.description: Rulers of the Tianyu Empire, maintaining balance between the Seven Noble Houses through Dugu Zhantian’s 1 million soldiers.

faction-demonic-scheme.name: Demonic Scheme Sect
faction-demonic-scheme.description: Middle-three sect of the Western Continent; ruthless demonic sect where Zhuo Fan rises from Cemetery Laborer to supreme leader.

faction-double-dragon.name: Double Dragon Manor
faction-double-dragon.description: The supreme overlord institution of the Western Continent governed by the Black and White Exalteds, hosts of the 9 Sects Gathering.

faction-sword-star.name: Sword Star Empire & Baili Clan
faction-sword-star.description: The supreme superpower of the mortal domain led by Undefeated Sword Sovereign Baili Yutian and Prime Minister Baili Jingwei.

zhuo-fan.name: Zhuo Fan
zhuo-fan.description: Reincarnation of the 8th Demonic Emperor of the Sacred Domain, now the scheming Grand Butler of the Luo Clan.

luo-yunchang.name: Luo Yunchang
luo-yunchang.description: Eldest daughter of the Luo Clan who appointed Zhuo Fan as steward; steadfastly devoted to him through every tribulation.

luo-yunhai.name: Luo Yunhai
luo-yunhai.description: Young master and future Clan Head of the Luo Clan, trained ruthlessly by Zhuo Fan to become an iron-willed military leader.

li-jingtian.name: Li Jingtian
li-jingtian.description: Former martial fanatic elder of Regent Estate who yields to Zhuo Fan after being cured and receiving high-grade profound arts.

xue-qingjian.name: Xue Qingjian
xue-qingjian.description: Rogue Radiant Stage demonic expert recruited alongside Qiu Yanhai by Zhuo Fan to serve as Luo Clan Venerables.

qiu-yanhai.name: Qiu Yanhai
qiu-yanhai.description: Fierce rogue cultivator skilled in violent fire arts, husband of Xue Qingjian and devoted elder of the Luo Clan.

yan-song.name: Yan Song
yan-song.description: Pill King Hall’s greatest alchemist who was crushed by Zhuo Fan’s miraculous refining technique and became Luo Clan’s chief alchemist.

captain-pang.name: Captain Pang
captain-pang.description: Loyal guard captain of the Luo Clan who protected Luo Yunchang and Luo Yunhai during their darkest exile.

lei-yuting.name: Lei Yuting
lei-yuting.description: Fierce bandit leader daughter from Black Wind Mountain who pledged allegiance to the Luo Clan after Zhuo Fan restructured the fortress.

huangpu-qingtian.name: Huangpu Qingtian
aliases: Eldest Young Master of Regent Estate
huangpu-qingtian.description: The invincible prodigy of the Seven Noble Houses possessing the Nine Dragons Diamond Body; Zhuo Fan’s greatest mortal rival.

huangpu-tianyuan.name: Huangpu Tianyuan
huangpu-tianyuan.description: Ruthless Estate Lord of Regent Estate seeking to unite all 7 Houses and conquer the Tianyu Imperial throne.

leng-wuchang.name: Leng Wuchang
leng-wuchang.description: Regent Estate’s mastermind advisor, one of Tianyu’s Three Great Sages whose infallible calculations clash with Zhuo Fan.

huangpu-qingyun.name: Huangpu Qingyun
aliases: Second Young Master of Regent Estate
huangpu-qingyun.description: Arrogant second son of Regent Estate killed by Zhuo Fan at Drifting Flowers City, igniting total war.

chu-qingcheng.name: Chu Qingcheng
chu-qingcheng.description: Leader of Drifting Flowers Edifice and the true soulmate of Zhuo Fan, for whom he defied Heaven and Earth.

xiao-dandan.name: Xiao Dandan
xiao-dandan.description: Junior disciple of Drifting Flowers Edifice who fell hopelessly in love with Zhuo Fan’s Gu Santong/Song Yu disguise.

chu-bijun.name: Chu Bijun
chu-bijun.description: Blind matriarch and pillar of Drifting Flowers Edifice whose profound wisdom helped guide Chu Qingcheng and Zhuo Fan.

long-jiu.name: Long Jiu
long-jiu.description: Veiled Dragon Pavilion elder with a cybernetic/lightning eye who formed the first noble alliance with Zhuo Fan.

long-yifei.name: Long Yifei
long-yifei.description: Leader of Veiled Dragon Pavilion who threw the full weight of his house behind Zhuo Fan against Regent Estate.

long-kui.name: Long Kui
long-kui.description: Fiery young genius of Veiled Dragon Pavilion who initially looked down on servant Zhuo Fan before being humbled.

xie-tianshang.name: Xie Tianshang
xie-tianshang.description: Sword Marquise Abode’s supreme sword cultivator who respects Zhuo Fan’s unyielding martial dao above clan politics.

xie-tianyang.name: Xie Tianyang
xie-tianyang.description: Hot-blooded friend of Zhuo Fan and lover of Xue Ningxiang who fought alongside the Luo Clan during the Esoteric Debate.

xie-xiaofeng.name: Xie Xiaofeng
xie-xiaofeng.description: Stern leader of Sword Marquise Abode who committed his sword legions to the Grand Luo Alliance.

you-guiqi.name: You Guiqi
you-guiqi.description: Hell Valley’s mastermind elder, one of Tianyu’s Three Great Sages whose poison and conspiracies were crushed by Zhuo Fan.

you-guishan.name: You Guishan
you-guishan.description: Vengeful ruler of Hell Valley consumed with destroying Zhuo Fan after You Guiqi and You Quan’s executions.

you-quan.name: You Quan
aliases: Fifth Young Master of Hell Valley
you-quan.description: Cruel youth who attempted to slaughter the Luo Clan in Black Wind Mountain, Zhuo Fan’s first major kill.

yan-bogong.name: Yan Bogong
yan-bogong.description: Leader of Pill King Hall who allied with Regent Estate to preserve his alchemical monopoly.

yan-fu.name: Yan Fu
yan-fu.description: Talented alchemist who turned against Pill King Hall to follow his master Yan Song into the Luo Clan.

lin-rufeng.name: Lin Rufeng
lin-rufeng.description: Speed-specialist noble master of Merry Woods, loyal henchman of Regent Estate during the civil war.

yuwen-feng.name: Yuwen Feng
yuwen-feng.description: Machiavellian Emperor who orchestrated the civil war between the 7 Houses to consolidate absolute imperial power.

yuwen-cong.name: Yuwen Cong
yuwen-cong.description: Gluttonous, loyal Third Prince who befriended Zhuo Fan in obscurity and was later crowned Emperor by the Luo Clan.

zhuge-changfeng.name: Zhuge Changfeng
zhuge-changfeng.description: The cunning Prime Minister of Tianyu who led the Quanrong alliance conspiracy; Tianyu’s greatest political schemer.

dugu-zhantian.name: Dugu Zhantian
dugu-zhantian.description: Pillar general of Tianyu, adoptive father of Luo Yunhai whose million-strong iron army kept the noble houses at bay.

dugu-four-tigers.name: Four Tigers of Tianyu
dugu-four-tigers.description: Adopted brothers of Luo Yunhai and marshals of the Dugu Army, renowned for their unbeatable combined battle arrays.

xie-wuyue.name: Xie Wuyue
xie-wuyue.description: Ambitious, cold-blooded Sect Leader of Demonic Scheme Sect who brought Zhuo Fan to the Western Continent to win the Double Dragon tournament.

yuan-xinggang.name: Yuan Xinggang
yuan-xinggang.description: Secret grandmaster disguised as a lowly sweeper in Demonic Scheme Sect; Zhuo Fan’s beloved Daoist mentor.

ye-lin.name: Ye Lin
ye-lin.description: Disciple of the Sacred Beast Decisive Golden Dragon; the greatest genius of the Western Continent and Zhuo Fan’s sworn rival/brother.

danqing-shen.name: Danqing Shen
danqing-shen.description: Legendary sword cultivator of the Western Lands who defected to the Central Continent seeking the peak of sword dao.

wu-qingqiu.name: Wu Qingqiu
wu-qingqiu.description: Senior disciple of Heavenly Cycle Sect, respected noble leader of the Western Lands youth before Zhuo Fan and Ye Lin emerged.

double-dragon-exalted.name: Double Dragon Exalted
double-dragon-exalted.description: The twin Genesis Stage supreme guardians of the Western Lands who oversee the Double Dragon Manor.

baili-yutian.name: Baili Yutian
baili-yutian.description: The peerless master of the Central Continent who single-handedly dominated the Five Continents for millennia.

baili-jingwei.name: Baili Jingwei
baili-jingwei.description: The intellectual architect of the Sword Star Empire whose macro-continental stratagems met their match in Zhuo Fan.

baili-yuyu.name: Baili Yuyu
baili-yuyu.description: One of the Nine Sword Kings of the Sword Star Empire, an assassin master who developed deep, complicated ties with Zhuo Fan.

kunpeng.name: Kunpeng
kunpeng.description: One of the Five Primordial Sacred Beasts who bestowed the Heaven-Cleaving Wings and primordial beast energy upon Zhuo Fan.

nine-serenities-emperor.name: Nine Serenities Emperor
nine-serenities-emperor.description: The ancient primordial Sovereign who authored the Nine Serenities Secret Art and Demon Transformation Art mastered by Zhuo Fan.

zhao-chen.name: Zhao Chen
zhao-chen.description: Zhuo Yifan’s trusted disciple who betrayed him to the Seven Sacred Mountains in the Sacred Domain, triggering his reincarnation.

loc-windgale-city.name: Windgale City & Black Wind Mountain
loc-windgale-city.description: Origin fortress of the Luo Clan, fortified by Zhuo Fan with impenetrable 5th and 6th-grade grand spirit arrays.

loc-veiled-dragon-pavilion.name: Veiled Dragon Pavilion (Dragon City)
loc-veiled-dragon-pavilion.description: The subterranean fortress and banking capital of Veiled Dragon Pavilion, guarded by thunder arrays.

loc-hell-valley.name: Hell Valley (Yin-Yang Abyss)
loc-hell-valley.description: A gloomy canyon filled with toxic miasma and ghost wails, headquarters of Hell Valley.

loc-drifting-flowers-city.name: Drifting Flowers City & Edifice
loc-drifting-flowers-city.description: The floral capital of Drifting Flowers Edifice, venue of the Hundred Pill Gathering where Zhuo Fan displayed miraculous pill alchemy.

loc-pill-king-hall.name: Pill King Hall (King of Medicine Valley)
loc-pill-king-hall.description: Ancient cauldron valley filled with spirit medicinal herb gardens and supreme pill cauldrons.

loc-sword-marquis-abode.name: Sword Marquis Abode (Ten Thousand Swords Mountain)
loc-sword-marquis-abode.description: A mountain peak jutting like an unsheathed blade into the clouds, bristling with ancestral sword spirits.

loc-dugu-encampment.name: Dugu Military Encampment (Western Border)
loc-dugu-encampment.description: The fortified frontline base of Dugu Zhantian’s million soldiers defending Tianyu from the Quanrong beasts.

loc-dragon-cloud-city.name: Dragon Cloud City (Tianyu Imperial Capital)
loc-dragon-cloud-city.description: The monumental capital of the Tianyu Empire, venue of the 100-year Esoteric Debate and grand court politics.

loc-beast-king-mountain.name: Beast King Mountain (Hundred Crags Mountain)
loc-beast-king-mountain.description: A deadly spirit beast mountain range used as the brutal battleground for the Esoteric Debate.

loc-regent-estate.name: Regent Estate (Dragon-taming Peak)
loc-regent-estate.description: The golden citadel of Regent Estate built upon the royal dragon veins of Tianyu.

loc-demon-scheming-sect.name: Demonic Scheme Sect Mountain (Cemetery of Laborers)
loc-demon-scheming-sect.description: A dark, jagged mountain in the Western Continent housing the Laborer Cemetery and Elite Laborer Hall.

loc-double-dragon-manor.name: Double Dragon Manor (Summit of Western Lands)
loc-double-dragon-manor.description: Floating jade island above the clouds hosting the 9 Sects Double Dragon Gathering.

loc-sword-star-capital.name: Sword Star Imperial Capital (Central Continent)
loc-sword-star-capital.description: The gargantuan capital of the Sword Star Empire, center of the Five Continents’ political gravity.

loc-demonic-emperor-peak.name: Demonic Emperor Peak (Sacred Domain)
loc-demonic-emperor-peak.description: The ancient mountaintop retreat of Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan in the Sacred Domain where he obtained the Nine Serenities Secret Art.

arc-windgale-rise.name: Windgale Rise & Black Wind Mountain
arc-windgale-rise.description: Zhuo Fan reincarnates, protects the Luo orphans, kills You Quan, and establishes Black Wind Fortress.

arc-drifting-flowers.name: Drifting Flowers Hundred Pill Gathering
arc-drifting-flowers.description: Zhuo Fan enters Drifting Flowers City disguised as Song Yu, defeats Yan Song, falls for Chu Qingcheng, and kills Huangpu Qingyun.

arc-esoteric-debate.name: Tianyu Esoteric Debate Arc
arc-esoteric-debate.description: The 100-year tournament where Zhuo Fan annihilates Huangpu Qingtian, elevates the Luo Clan, and breaks Regent Estate.

arc-tianyu-chaos.name: Tianyu Civil War & Imperial Purge
arc-tianyu-chaos.description: The Emperor’s conspiracy unfolds alongside Quanrong invasion; Zhuo Fan outsmarts Zhuge Changfeng and crowns Yuwen Cong.

arc-double-dragon.name: Western Continent Double Dragon Gathering
arc-double-dragon.description: Zhuo Fan enters Demonic Scheme Sect, transforms the Laborer Hall, and leads the sect to supreme victory at the 9 Sects Gathering.

arc-sword-star-sacred.name: Five Continents Clash & Sacred Domain War
arc-sword-star-sacred.description: Zhuo Fan battles Baili Yutian, reclaims his memories, confronts the Seven Sacred Mountains, and achieves Sovereign realm.

event-reincarnation.name: Betrayal & Fall at Demonic Emperor Peak
event-reincarnation.description: Betrayed by his first disciple Zhao Chen and besieged by the Seven Sacred Mountains, Zhuo Yifan detonates his soul with the Nine Serenities Secret Scripture atop Demonic Emperor Peak.

event-hundred-pill-victory.name: Hundred Pill Gathering Miraculous Victory
event-hundred-pill-victory.description: Zhuo Fan refines the Heaven-Defying Pill with his bare hands, crushing Yan Song and cementing his bond with Chu Qingcheng.

event-esoteric-duel.name: Duel of the Dragons: Zhuo Fan vs Huangpu Qingtian
event-esoteric-duel.description: Zhuo Fan invokes the Blood Infant and Heavenly Demon Eye to decapitate Huangpu Qingtian, shocking the Seven Houses.

event-double-dragon-clash.name: Double Dragon Finale: Zhuo Fan vs Ye Lin
event-double-dragon-clash.description: The epic clash between the inheritor of Kunpeng and the inheritor of the Decisive Golden Dragon.

loc-merry-woods.name: Merry Woods (Kuai Huo Lin)
loc-merry-woods.description: The pleasure, gambling, and entertainment metropolis of the Seven Noble Houses, secretly serving as the shadow intelligence gathering apparatus for Regent Estate and Hell Valley.

loc-thunder-canyon.name: Thunder Canyon & Lightning Gorge
loc-thunder-canyon.description: A terrifying mountain chasm crackling with ancient 12th-grade Purple Lightning arrays where Zhuo Fan absorbed pure purple lightning, bonded the Lightning Skylark, and claimed the Heaven-Reaching Demonic Ring.

loc-quanrong-border.name: Quanrong Empire & Wolf Beast Garrison
loc-quanrong-border.description: The militaristic nomadic empire northwest of Tianyu, possessing vicious spirit beast armies commanded by Grand Commander Tuoba Tieshan and the Eight Wolf Commanders.

loc-all-dragon-mountain.name: All Dragon Mountain (Imperial Dragon Tomb)
loc-all-dragon-mountain.description: The sacred subterranean dragon mountain where Tianyu’s nine Earth Dragon spirit veins converge, site of the apocalyptic duel between Emperor Yuwen and Zhuo Fan.

loc-mysterious-heaven-sect.name: Mysterious Heaven Sect (Xuan Tian Zong)
loc-mysterious-heaven-sect.description: A prominent mid-tier Western sect nestled in high misty peaks where Chu Qingcheng and Drifting Flowers Edifice disciples sought refuge prior to the Double Dragon Gathering.

loc-ultimate-clear-sect.name: Ultimate Clear Sect (Tai Qing Zong)
loc-ultimate-clear-sect.description: The undisputed supreme sect of the Western Lands, home to prodigy Ye Lin, sacred inheritor of the Golden Dragon Sacred Beast.

loc-sea-bright-sect.name: Sea Bright Sect (Northern Lands)
loc-sea-bright-sect.description: The supreme guardian sect of the frozen Northern Lands, wielders of the divine Heaven-Sealing Sword and home of the Murong and Ouyang clans.

loc-shangguan-clan.name: Shangguan Clan Domain (Southern Lands)
loc-shangguan-clan.description: The ancestral bamboo jungle domain of the Shangguan Clan in the Southern Lands, guardians of the Heaven-Soaring Sword who resisted Sword Star Empire’s imperial expansion.

loc-seven-sacred-mountains.name: Seven Sacred Mountains (Sacred Domain)
loc-seven-sacred-mountains.description: The supreme hegemons and tyrannical rulers of the Sacred Domain Upper Realm who betrayed and ordered the execution of Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan.

event-reincarnation-windgale.name: Reincarnation of Servant Zhuo Fan
event-reincarnation-windgale.description: Zhuo Yifan’s remnant soul awakens within the murdered servant Zhuo Fan in Windgale City, binding himself by Heart Demon oath to protect the Luo siblings.

event-purple-lightning-absorption.name: Absorption of 12th-Grade Purple Lightning
event-purple-lightning-absorption.description: Zhuo Fan braves the lethal Thunder Canyon, absorbs 1st-tier Purple Lightning into his soul, tames the Lightning Skylark, and claims the Heaven-Reaching Demonic Ring.

event-pill-king-bodhi-duel.name: Alchemy Duel of Bodhi Jade Sap
event-pill-king-bodhi-duel.description: Zhuo Fan uses ancient demonic alchemy to refine heaven-grade Bodhi Jade Sap, completely humiliating Poison Hand Yan Song and shattering Pill King Hall’s prestige.

event-hell-valley-raid.name: Night Raid on Hell Valley & Demise of You Guiqi
event-hell-valley-raid.description: Zhuo Fan outmaneuvers Hell Valley’s insidious strategist You Guiqi, slaughtering his vanguard and sealing the impending downfall of the nether abyss.

event-imperial-bestowal-luo.name: Imperial Bestowal: Luo Clan Crowned 8th House
event-imperial-bestowal-luo.description: Emperor Yuwen confers supreme noble house status upon the Luo Clan in Dragon Cloud City; Zhuo Fan is hailed as the empire’s rising demonic dragon and Chief Steward.

event-regent-estate-extinction.name: Fall of Dragon-Taming Peak & Extinction of Regent Estate
event-regent-estate-extinction.description: Zhuo Fan unleashes his devastating demonic power, obliterates Huangpu Tianyuan’s Nine Earth Dragon body, and wipes the Regent Estate off the face of Tianyu.

event-dugu-zhantian-sacrifice.name: The Emperor’s Treason & Fall of Marshal Dugu Zhantian
event-dugu-zhantian-sacrifice.description: Emperor Yuwen secretly colludes with the Quanrong beast army to ambush Dugu Zhantian; the four tigers mourn their loyal godfather as Zhuo Fan vows vengeance.

event-elite-laborer-hall-rise.name: Rise of the Elite Laborer Hall
event-elite-laborer-hall-rise.description: Zhuo Fan turns the abandoned Cemetery of Laborers into the Demon Scheming Sect’s greatest powerhouse, training disciples that surpass the inner court elders.

event-xie-wuyue-overthrown.name: Deposition of Xie Wuyue & Zhuo Fan Crowned Sect Master
event-xie-wuyue-overthrown.description: Blind with envy, Sect Master Xie Wuyue attempts to execute the laborers; Zhuo Fan rallies the venerable elders and deposes Xie Wuyue with Double Dragon Manor’s backing.

event-sword-star-infiltration.name: Infiltration of Sword Star Empire & Clash with Baili Yutian
event-sword-star-infiltration.description: Zhuo Fan infiltrates the Baili Clan’s imperial capital, clashing with the Undefeated Sword Sovereign Baili Yutian in a titanic display of dragon and sword dao.
